braton.circuitRotationText: Week 1 Rotation (Braton, Lato, Skana, Paris, Kunai)
braton.acquisition:
Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Braton Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Braton with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.
braton.overview:
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 20 weakpoints will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by Sonar or Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Swapping to normal mode while there are charges remaining will waste those charges.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Braton's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 10 rounds to a maximum of 200. Once all ammunition is expended, the Braton reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

vasto.acquisition:
Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Vasto Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Vasto with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for 120 Platinum, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.
vasto.overview:
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 8 weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by Sonar or Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Vasto's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 3 rounds to a maximum of 24. Once all ammunition is expended, the Vasto reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

sicarus.overview:
Weakpoint hits charge Incarnon Transmutation; Alt Fire transmutes. Switching back will expend any remaining charge.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.

Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by Sonar or Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Sicarus's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 10 rounds to a maximum of 120. Once all ammunition is expended, the Sicarus reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

stug.overview:

1 Incarnon charge is given on direct hit. 1 charge is given when a blob explodes, but only if the blob is attached to an enemy (charge is only given from the attached target, not surrounding enemies hit by the explosion). 0 charge is given from the embed DoT damage.
Once an enemy is killed, leftover blobs stuck to them will not give charge when they explode.
Shooting additional blobs onto a blob that's already attached to an enemy will still grant 1 charge for each direct hit. However, only 1 total charge will be given for the final blob explosion, regardless of how many blobs are combined.
Because of this, Incarnon charge can be built faster by spreading out shots rather than stacking blobs in one spot. This will allow every shot to grant 2 charges; 1 from the direct hit and 1 from the explosion.
Multishot increases blob size rather than the number of blobs, so it does not increase the number of Incarnon charges gained per blob.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Stug's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 4 rounds to a maximum of 120. Once all ammunition is expended, the Stug reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.
